description: FDA recalls and enforcement: Food, drug or device enforcement reports from openFDA matching a query (firm, product or reason, or one named field): classification (Class I–III), status, reason, dates, state and distribution, newest first, up to 25. Source: openFDA. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: recalls[]{recall_number, firm, product, reason, classification, status, initiated, state}.

field.description: limit the match to one openFDA field such as recalling_firm or product_description (optional)

query.description: words to match, e.g. a firm or product name

name: x420_gov_fda-recalls
